messages:
tara: starting canary for ranking-service v4.1 -> v4.2 (global). change window 1h. start at 5% -> 25% if stable. watch slo/rank_p95 and error/5xx.

deploy-bot: canary started: ranking-service:v4.2 at 5% traffic. monitors: slo/rank_p95, metric/http_5xx_rate, route:/v1/rank. watchlist: beta-partner.
mike: FYI v4.2 enables float16 kernels for a perf boost; should lower p50 but might increase memory on some instances.

anna: seeing p95 jump for /v1/rank from 220ms -> 1.4s and 5xx from 0.01% -> 0.8% over last 2m. tenant="beta-partner" is the top emitter.

mike: running quick prom query:

```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{route=\"/v1/rank\",status=~\"5..\"}[1m])) by (tenant)
```

returns tenant="beta-partner" -> 9rps. others ~0.

sre: checking node OOMs/evictions. saw transient OOMs on infer-n1 group in eu-central around the timeframe. may be float16 kernel mem regression.

tara: decision: pause the rollout at 5% and pin tenant-level routing for beta-partner -> v4.1. do not rollback cluster-wide. @deploy-bot apply tenant pin and stop traffic shifts.
deploy-bot: ack. tenant pin applied: tenant=beta-partner -> ranking-service:v4.1. canary paused at 5%. audit:event emitted. Notification posted to #incidents.

anna: after pin, beta-partner 5xx dropped back to baseline within 60s and p95 recovered. confirming routing table shows tenant override.
mike: I'll open a quick mitigation to disable float16 fallback for affected instance types and push a patch. will include perf regression assessment.

sre: suppressed routed alert for tenant=beta-partner while pin is active. suppression expires when pin removed.
tara: extending change window +2h to let infra and mike validate the patch. we'll reconvene before resuming. add short note to release notes: "v4.2: float16 kernel enabled; regional/tenant pin applied during canary for beta-partner".

alerts-bot: reminder: manual pin in place — auto-unpin disabled.

mike: created PR https://redwood.internal/changes/PR-2001 with fix and test results. tagging @tara for verification.
tara: thanks all — nice catch.
